end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Matched everyday objects, including cake tin, laddu, ball, gas cylinder and dice, to 3D shapes.
Described cube faces, cuboid rectangular faces and curved surfaces on cylinder, cone and sphere.
Asked for visual examples and requested more lesson time; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised naming 3D shapes and matching them with everyday objects. They explained the method using faces and curved surfaces, such as square faces for a cube and a consistent round side for a cylinder. They mixed up the idea of curved surfaces by saying all three shapes have a fully curved side; this was not corrected in a later response. At home, ask them to sort a dice, box, ball, tin and cone-shaped object by shape and describe one face or surface.
